\paragraph{Contributions.}
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
    \item We identify CIVO as a failure mode specific to imagination-based world-model RL with temporal abstraction, and isolate trained temporal embedding combined with multi-rate data exposure as the causal trigger through factorial experiments across two environments with 6 seeds (6/6 exceed NVE threshold, 5/6 collapse).
    \item We decompose the CIVO gradient pathway: gradient magnitude does not predict causal importance (reward head: largest gradient, 38--49\%, yet reward-only stopping fails; observation decoder: 16--22\%, yet causally critical). Targeted obs-decoder-only SGS guided by this decomposition achieves only 1/6 prevention across two environments (versus 0/3 for full-pathway SGS), confirming that CIVO operates through redundant gradient pathways that no single-target intervention addresses.
    \item We provide a lightweight online detector achieving 100\% sensitivity (5/5) with predictive warning in 2/5 cases, without requiring a reference baseline.
    \item We identify the feedback architecture (imagination-based bootstrapping vs.\ MPC re-planning) as the structural factor explaining why $\dt$-conditioning succeeds in TD-MPC2 but fails in DreamerV3.
    \item We construct a three-level intervention hierarchy (gradient, output, representation) spanning 9 configurations: gradient-level SGS (0--17\%), output-level value capping (0\%), and representation-level TCN (50\% on Walker only, 0\% cross-environment). Even the most effective level achieves only environment-specific partial mitigation with high eval variance (45--91\%), establishing CIVO as resistant to all tested intervention strategies.
\end{enumerate}

\paragraph{Contributions.}
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
    \item \textbf{Failure mode identification.} We identify CIVO as specific to imagination-based actor-critic with temporal conditioning and isolate trained $\dt$-embedding $+$ multi-rate exposure as jointly necessary through factorial experiments (6/6 seeds exceed NVE threshold, 5/6 collapse across two environments).
    \item \textbf{MPC vs.\ imagination boundary.} We identify the feedback architecture as the structural factor: $\dt$-conditioning succeeds in TD-MPC2's MPC re-planning but fails under imagination-based bootstrapping, where model errors compound into biased value targets with no real-data anchor.
    \item \textbf{Gradient magnitude $\neq$ causal importance.} The reward head contributes the largest gradient share (38--49\%) yet reward-only stopping fails; the observation decoder (16--22\%) is causally critical. Obs-decoder SGS achieves only 1/6 prevention, confirming redundant gradient pathways.
    \item \textbf{Three-level intervention hierarchy.} Across 9 configurations at gradient, output, and representation levels, no intervention reliably eliminates CIVO. TCN ($\sigma{=}0.2$) achieves 2/3 on Walker but 0\% cross-environment; the effective Cheetah dose destroys learning (eval 27\%).
    \item \textbf{Online detection.} A lightweight NVE-based detector achieves 100\% sensitivity (5/5) with predictive warning in 2/5 cases, enabling early termination of compromised runs.
\end{enumerate}

## 1. 标准过估值对策讨论：机制区分（P0 关键）

Reviewer 指出这段讨论必须区分两种 overestimation 机制，不能写成泛泛的"相关工作列举"：

- **Standard countermeasures (Double Q / TD3 / ensemble)** 解决的是 **estimation error** — critic 训练过程中的函数逼近误差导致 Q 值偏高。这是 training-time artifact。
- **CIVO 的 overestimation** 源自 **world model fidelity gap** — RSSM 在 dt>1 的预测不精确，但 trained dt_embedding 让 critic "以为" 预测是精确的，从而在 forward pass 就输入了有偏的状态。这是 input-level bias，不是 estimation noise。

核心论点：**Standard countermeasures address the symptom (critic overestimation); CIVO's root cause is upstream — in the world model's forward pass, not in the critic's training dynamics.** 即便用 ensemble critics 降低了 estimation noise，如果 imagination states 本身就是 biased 的（RSSM fidelity gap），ensemble 只会 agree on the wrong value。

请确保这段写得有论证深度，不是简单的"这些方法太贵/太难实现"。

**旧**: "partial mitigation with narrow effectiveness window"
**新**: "TCN provides the only observed reduction in CIVO severity among tested interventions, but remains unreliable even under optimal conditions (2/3 Walker Walk seeds, 0/4 cross-environment configs)"

关键叙事调整：
- TCN 的价值不是作为 mitigation，而是作为 **diagnostic contrast** — 它证明 representation-level 是正确的干预层级方向
- 从 "narrow window exists" → "window may not exist reliably"

164	\subsection{Forward-Pass Interventions}
165	\label{sec:forward_results}
166	
167	The SGS results establish gradient stopping as categorically insufficient. We test two forward-pass alternatives (Table~\ref{tab:intervention_hierarchy}). \textbf{RAVE} (value-level capping) fails: the EMA anchor tracks biased values during CIVO onset. \textbf{TCN} (representation-level noise) on Walker Walk shows dose-dependent behavior: $\sigma{=}0.5$ produces oscillatory CIVO (eval $\leq 40\%$), while $\sigma{=}0.2$ prevents CIVO in 2/3 Walker seeds (NVE $< 1.0\times$, eval 45--91\%); seed~2 exhibits NVE breakthrough ($1.65\times$). On Cheetah Run, $\sigma \leq 0.5$ fails while $\sigma{=}1.0$ prevents CIVO (NVE ${<}\,0.25\times$) but destroys learning (eval 27\%), an ``impossible dose'' dilemma. TCN also fails on PickCube-v1; trajectories in Appendix~\ref{sec:tcn_cross_env}.
